annotations.title: FDA food, drug and device recalls

description: Searches FDA recall enforcement reports published through openFDA for food, drugs and medical devices, newest report date first. Optional filters: keywords (every word must appear in the product description, reason for recall, recalling firm or lot/code information; "quoted phrases" are kept together), product type, classification (Class I, II or III), status and report-date range. Returns recall number, class, status, firm, product, reason, distribution, dates and a link to the openFDA record. The data is FDA's weekly Enforcement Report (2012 onward), which can lag FDA's recall announcements.

classification.description: FDA recall class. Class I is the most serious.

detail.description: "brief" (default) keeps each result short; "full" adds the complete text fields.

limit.description: Results per page (1-25, default 10). At most 10 without product_type or for devices, and at most 5 with detail "full".

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (0-100). Without product_type, offset + limit can be at most 20.

product_type.description: Limit to one FDA product type. Omit to search all three.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "peanut butter", "listeria", "insulin pen", a firm name or a lot number. Up to 6 words. Optional.

status.description: Recall status in the Enforcement Report.

name: food_drug_device_recalls
